name: azure-identity-dotnet
summary: 微软的指南以 Azure Blob Storage 为例，介绍如何在 .NET 中使用 Microsoft Entra ID 为 Azure SDK 客户端进行身份验证。可通过 `dotnet add package Azure.Identity` 添加 NuGet 包。ASP.NET Core 示例演示了如何按运行环境选择凭据。使用用户分配的托管标识示例时，需要提供该标识的客户端 ID。

Microsoft’s guide shows how to authenticate Azure SDK clients in .NET with Microsoft Entra ID, using Azure Blob Storage as an example. Add the Azure.Identity NuGet package with `dotnet add package Azure.Identity`. The ASP.NET Core example shows how to choose credentials by environment. To use the user-assigned managed identity example, you need that identity’s client ID.
